description: Department of Census and Statistics - The Census Ordinance ( Chapter 143 ) The Third Stage of the Census of Population and Housing - 2024
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the enactment of rules and the exercise of powers under the Census Ordinance (Chapter 143). It contains regulatory frameworks, legal powers vested in a minister, and detailed procedural rules for conducting a census, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a named minister (Anura Kumara Dissanayake), the core content is about legal authority and regulatory procedures rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
